exposure: Expectant management (3000 mL of intravenous isotonic fluids daily)
cohort: 79 pregnant women diagnosed with oligohydramnios at 18-32 weeks gestation.
finding: Amnioinfusion for oligohydramnios in the second and early third trimesters did not significantly improve perinatal mortality but was associated with prolonged delivery latency, reduced cesarean delivery rates, and improved neonatal outcomes, especially for women <=26 weeks with a high risk of neonatal bronchopulmonary hypoplasia.
